hero.name: Fenley Menelas

about.heading: About me
about.paragraph1: I'm a software engineer who helps companies turn ideas into products. I work end-to-end — architecture, front-end, back-end, databases and deployment — with a bias for simple, maintainable code that ships on time.
about.paragraph2: I've worked with clients in Haiti, the United States and Europe, remotely and on site. I communicate in English, French and Spanish, and I'm used to working across time zones.
